source_documents.title: Unified Framework for Photophysical Rate Calculations in TADF Molecules

reference_evidence_units.quote: For the 4CzIPN molecule, great agreement is found between predicted and experimental ISC rates.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Nuclear-ensemble rate calculation versus literature experimental rates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors report good ISC agreement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Experimental values are cited from earlier studies, not newly measured in this paper.

reference_evidence_units.quote: underestimate the experimental value by 2 orders of magnitude
reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Calculated rISC rate compared with cited experiment.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target rISC rate is substantially underestimated.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not replace this mismatch with the smaller factor-of-three mismatch of PTZ-DBTO2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 4CzIPN simulated time- resolved decay shows no contribution from phosphorescence
reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Kinetic model populated by calculated rates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The model predicts fluorescence-dominated decay with negligible phosphorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A computed absence is not a new experimental exclusion of every triplet process; rISC still participates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a strong prompt component with a 6 ns lifetime, close to the experimental value of 14 ns
reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Simulated prompt fluorescence compared with cited experimental decay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The prompt lifetime is 6 ns in the calculation versus 14 ns in the cited experiment.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preserve numerical mismatch rather than calling it quantitative agreement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: an estimated lifetime of 45 μs, again overestimating the experimental value of almost 2 μs
reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Delayed fluorescence kinetic model versus literature experiment.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Delayed fluorescence is much too long in the model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The calculated curve resembles lower-temperature data; it should not be treated as an accurately validated room-temperature lifetime.

reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 3, calculated kF/kP and experimental kF from reference 46.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated kF is 9.3 x 10^7 and kP is 1.7 x 10^1 s^-1; cited experimental kF is 1.7 x 10^7 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source's calculations and referenced experiments are separate provenance layers.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the harmonic approximation that is behind the procedure of geometry sampling may overlook important anharmonic contributions
reference_evidence_units.subject: 4CzIPN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' discussion of the simulated temperature mismatch.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors suggest missing anharmonic contributions as one explanation for disagreement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a proposed model limitation, not demonstrated RIM or conical-intersection evidence.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper's central contribution is a unified radiative/ISC/rISC rate and state-population account.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: TADF and ISC/rISC are explicit target processes; computed phosphorescence is negligible.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
